title: allowlister config
description: Configuration for allowlister: allow/deny/ask rules for AI coding-agent shell commands and tool calls. Files are JSONC (strict JSON plus // line and /* */ block comments).

$schema.description: URI of this JSON Schema, so editors validate and autocomplete the config.

name.description: Optional profile name (metadata; ignored by the loader).

description.description: Optional profile description (metadata; ignored by the loader).

rules.description: Rules evaluated against each command fragment or tool call. Order never changes the verdict (deny > ask > allow > defer), only which rule is cited in the reason.

history.description: Opt-in local usage-history recording. A later-loaded config (project over user) wins.

enabled.description: Record each evaluation (verdict plus parsed subcommands) to disk. Off by default.

action.description: What the rule does when it matches. Defaults to 'allow'.

kind.description: How 'match'/'argv' patterns are interpreted. Defaults to 'glob'.

role.description: Restrict the rule to fragments in this shell role. Default: any role.

glob.description: A single glob or an array of globs (any-of).

redirections.description: Per-rule redirection policy. By default out-redirects are denied and in-redirects to named files are allowed.

deny.description: Forbid all redirections on a matched command (overrides the globs below).

params.description: Canonical, portable tool parameters, each mapped to one or more globs (any-of). A missing param means the rule does not match.

rule.description: A shell-command rule (sets exactly one of 'match' or 'argv') or a tool-call rule (sets 'tool'). The two forms are mutually exclusive.

bashRule.description: Gates a shell command. Sets exactly one of 'match' or 'argv'.

name.description: Human-readable identifier shown in the decision reason.

match.description: Pattern matched against the command's argv joined by spaces.

argv.description: Per-element argv patterns; a trailing '**' matches any tail.

roles.description: Restrict the rule to these shell roles. Default: any role.

grants.description: 'command' (default) authorizes the command itself; 'redirections' only widens redirection targets for an already-authorized command (requires action 'allow' and a 'redirections' block).

toolRule.description: Gates a non-shell tool call. Sets 'tool' and must not set any bash-only field.

name.description: Human-readable identifier shown in the decision reason.

tool.description: A capability (read, write, edit, glob, grep, web_fetch, web_search), 'mcp', or a raw tool-name glob such as 'mcp__github__*'.

jsonpath.description: Match an MCP server's own (non-portable) parameters by a dotted path into the raw tool input, each mapped to one or more globs.
